summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale combined missile and drone attack targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, including Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones. Ukrainian intelligence indicates Russia is finalizing preparations for a new massive strike targeting energy infrastructure, logistics, and life-support systems. Ukrainian forces struck the Marinovka airfield in Volgograd region with Neptune missiles, destroying Russian Su-34 bombers used for glide bomb attacks.
key_points: Multiple Geran-5 missiles struck Kyiv's Desnyansky district and Brovary while reactive Shahed drones penetrated Obolonsky district and Chabany area. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78799, @mon1tor_ua/78789)
Russian Tu-160 strategic bomber relocated to Engels airbase for cruise missile loading; Tu-95MS bombers prepared for massive missile strike. (Source: @eRadarrua/133311)
Ukrainian Neptune coastal missiles struck Marinovka airfield in Volgograd, targeting Su-34 bombers that drop glide bombs. (Source: @UkraineNow/85553)
President Zelensky warns Russian forces finalizing new massive strike on energy, logistics, and life-support systems nationwide. (Source: @UkraineNow/85554)
Drones attacked Russian energy infrastructure: Nevinnomyskaya GRES in Stavropol Krai and Transneft station in Bashkortostan. (Source: @UkraineNow/85547, @UkraineNow/85544)
North Korea temporarily halted missile and artillery shell supplies to Russia following Russian diplomatic statements. (Source: @UkraineNow/85549)
US State Department approved $600 million F-16 equipment sale funded by Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands, and Norway. (Source: @UkraineNow/85551)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia regions. (Source: @kpszsu/99490, @kpszsu/99497)

Ukrainian intelligence indicates Russia is finalizing preparations for a new massive strike targeting energy infrastructure, logistics, and life-support systems. points: Ukrainian Neptune coastal missile system struck Marinovka airfield in Volgograd region, targeting Su-34 bombers that launch glide bombs on Ukrainian cities and positions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85553)

Ukrainian air defenses engaged Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones over Kyiv's Desnyansky district, Obolonsky district, Chabany, and Brovary throughout the reporting period. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78799, @mon1tor_ua/78789, @mon1tor_ua/78797)
Ukraine received $450 million from World Bank with Japanese support via RISE and SURGE programs, supporting small businesses and reconstruction projects. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24028)
Ukrainian aviation destroyed a Russian force accumulation point in Huliaipole, Zaporizhzhia region, used for offensive operations. (Source: @UkraineNow/85561)
Ukrainian drones attacked key Russian energy infrastructure: Nevinnomyskaya GRES in Stavropol Krai and Transneft pipeline station in Bashkortostan. (Source: @UkraineNow/85547, @UkraineNow/85544)
Cabinet of Ministers ordered verification of all men aged 17-60 for the Unified State Register of conscripts, servicemen, and reservists. (Source: @UkraineNow/85562)
Bodies of 250 Ukrainian servicemen were returned from Russia under existing agreements. (Source: @UkraineNow/85563)

Russian forces launched Geran-5 missiles at Kyiv's Desnyansky district and Brovary, and reactive Shahed drones at Obolonsky district and Chabany from multiple directions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78799, @mon1tor_ua/78789, @mon1tor_ua/78796)
Russian Tu-160 strategic bomber redeployed from Far East to Engels airbase for cruise missile loading; Tu-95MS bombers being prepared for massive missile strike. (Source: @eRadarrua/133311)
Russian tactical aviation conducted guided aerial bomb (KAB) strikes on Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia regions using Su-34 fighter-bombers. (Source: @kpszsu/99490, @kpszsu/99497)

Russian drone launches detected from Gvardeyskoye (1 reactive group), Primorsko-Akhtarsk (1 group), Kursk (4 groups), Orel (2 reactive groups), and Primorsko-Akhtarsk (3 groups). (Source: @eRadarrua/133361, @eRadarrua/133354)
Russian forces advanced near Petropavlivka on the eastern front according to updated mapping. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24030)
North Korea temporarily halted missile and artillery shell supplies to Russia following Russian deputy foreign minister statements on Korean Peninsula tensions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85549)
Crimea experienced massive blackout due to power grid failure outside the peninsula, affecting entire region and Sevastopol. (Source: @UkraineNow/85558)
Enemy forces advanced near Petropavlivka in the eastern sector per latest map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24030)
Russian guided aerial bombs struck Kharkiv and Sumy regions from tactical aviation. (Source: @kpszsu/99490)

Russian guided aerial bombs launched against Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/99497)

Reactive UAVs from northern Chernihiv region moved toward northern Kyiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/99481)
